messages:
Priya: Quick check — week-of hiring panels are next Tue/Wed. Need confirmation on who can cover the Tue 10:00am PT slot and whether we should use rubric v2-sr or v2-lite for the roles in that slot. Also need Zoom + room links. cc @Sam @Aisha
Sam: I can take Tue 10am PT. Are we switching to the new rubric weights? Jordan, last I recall you wanted more system-design emphasis for Sr roles.
Jordan: For Sr SWE we'll use v2-sr: System-design 40%, Execution 30%, Culture 30%. For IC2/IC3 use v2-lite. I'll post the final mapping to the hiring doc in a bit.
Aisha: Quick Q — two of these candidates have take-home exercises. Do panelists need to review solutions before the interview or save for debrief?
Priya: Good call — for consistency, panelists should NOT review take-homes before the live interview. Follow the debrief protocol in the hiring playbook: https://redwood.docs/hiring/debriefs . Interview-bot will attach the take-home links for post-interview review.
interview-bot: Scheduled: Tue 10:00 PT — Zoom: zoom.us/j/12345 — Room reserved: B2. Reminder will be sent 24h prior. :bell:
Sam: Got it. Can someone paste the quick scoring cheat-sheet for v2-lite vs v2-sr? Want to make sure grading is aligned.
Priya: Paste below for quick reference:
``v2-lite: Technical 50, Collaboration 30, Communication 20``
``v2-sr: System-design 40, Execution 30, Culture 30``
Use comment tags in the scorecard like `#anchor` for any strong concerns. We'll normalize scores during the debrief.
Aisha: Thanks — one more: if a panelist needs to swap at the last minute, ping me + Priya asap and I'll handle room/Zoom swaps. :+1:
Jordan: I'll upload candidate briefs + resume bundle by EOD today. Also need someone to own scribe/notes for Tue — can we pick?
Sam: I can scribe Tue 10am.
Priya: Perfect — marking Sam as scribe. Last ask: please set interview calendar invites to show the expected start times and include a 5-minute buffer between interviews.
Sam: Done — invites updated. Thanks team!
